== Summary ==
[[2009 World Championship]], Clarion Hotel, Princeton, New Jersey, 10 October 2009 (date from the camera's date stamp): "JSG and the sauce post day two". Identified: [[Jerry Heine]] ("the sauce", SWCCG T-shirt). "JSG" (beard, green cap) is not identified yet.

== Source ==
Photo by Flickr user punkybear (forum user Nibcrom), album "philly and jersey worlds": [https://www.flickr.com/photos/punkybear/4096154709/ JSG and the sauce post day two] (original image https://live.staticflickr.com/2691/4096154709_eee3fa3686_b.jpg). Several were posted to the forum thread [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=31192 2009 Worlds pictures] (topic 31192), e.g. [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=482550#p482550 post by Nibcrom], 12 November 2009.
